about.title: Communication across cultures
about.intro: Established in 2017, Yuan Ze University’s International Bachelor in Strategic Communication prepares students to communicate with purpose in a multilingual, multicultural world.
about.body: Taught entirely in English, IBSC brings together perspectives from the humanities, social sciences, design and business. Students develop the communication skills, practical experience and global outlook to find their strengths and shape their next chapter.

sections.title: A global classroom
sections.copy: Learn in an English-taught environment alongside students and faculty from different cultural backgrounds.

sections.title: Ideas into practice
sections.copy: Connect classroom learning with interdisciplinary projects, internships and opportunities to study abroad.

sections.title: People behind the program
sections.copy: Meet the faculty and staff who support learning, inquiry and student development.

academics.title: Ideas, Expression, Impact
academics.intro: Build a foundation in strategic communication and public relations, then explore the subjects and experiences that connect with your interests.
academics.body: The curriculum develops critical thinking, practical English writing and presentation, and teamwork across cultures. Foundational study is complemented by design, digital media and AI-related coursework, followed by advanced electives, internships and study abroad opportunities.

sections.title: Communicate with clarity
sections.copy: Develop skills in academic writing, English presentation, technical communication and intercultural communication.

sections.title: Create with new tools
sections.copy: Explore art and design, computer graphics, and multimedia content management and creation with AI.

sections.title: Understand audiences
sections.copy: Study persuasion, marketing, public relations and the meetings, incentives, conferences and exhibitions industry.

sample_courses: Multimedia Content Management and Creation with AI

student_life.title: Find your people, expand your world
student_life.intro: Campus life is part of the IBSC experience. Connect with classmates, take part in student activities and discover new perspectives through a community that crosses cultures.
student_life.body: The IBSC Student Association brings students together through events, workshops and networking. Beyond the classroom, service learning and international experiences offer ways to contribute, build confidence and put communication into practice.

sections.title: Make connections
sections.copy: Join the Student Association to meet peers, develop leadership skills and help shape campus life.
